ratman_guard.title: ratman_guard
ratman_guard.name: Rat-man
ratman_guard.description: 一种生活在成群殖群中的人形啮齿生物
ratman_guard.rumor: 岩石上涂满粪便。恶臭扑鼻

blinkbeast.title: blinkbeast
blinkbeast.name: Blinkbeast
blinkbeast.rumor: 此处有一种异样的寂静。远处闪烁着奇异光芒
blinkbeast.taunt: [color=#8050af]Blinkbeast[/color] 将你的身体拖过空气中的裂隙……

hobgoblin.title: hobgoblin
hobgoblin.name: Hobgoblin
hobgoblin.description: 强壮的隧道袭掠者。在隧道之地的浅层洞窟中打滚。觊觎神话中的“活金”
hobgoblin.rumor: 你听见粗陋铠甲的哐当声

hound_alpha.title: hound_alpha
hound_alpha.name: Hound Alpha
hound_alpha.description: 体型魁梧、不断吠叫的野兽
hound_alpha.taunt: [color=#f0a060]Hound Alpha[/color] 咬住你的喉咙。你的膝盖瘫软下去……

slagh_skirmisher.title: slagh_skirmisher
slagh_skirmisher.name: Slagh Skirmisher
slagh_skirmisher.description: 来自深林的施虐袭掠者。Slagh 部族的一员
slagh_skirmisher.rumor: 你看见一座苔藓祭坛，上面装饰着漂白头骨
slagh_skirmisher.taunt: [color=#30af40]Slagh Skirmisher[/color] 在你筋疲力尽的身体上方起舞……

mud_golem.title: mud_golem
mud_golem.name: Mud Wretch
mud_golem.description: 由一粒“活金”驱动的泥土巨躯
mud_golem.rumor: 尘土中留有宽大的脚印

heretic.title: heretic
heretic.name: Zindiq
heretic.rumor: 你看见一座被亵渎圣祠的残骸

irga_guard.title: irga_guard
irga_guard.name: Irga Guard
irga_guard.description: 来自地狱位面上方隧道的狂信士兵
irga_guard.rumor: 有传闻说，此地有佩戴黄金的劫掠者
irga_guard.taunt: [color=#ff0070]Irga Guard[/color] 将你拖向它的主人……

greenwyrm.title: greenwyrm
greenwyrm.name: Green Wyrm
greenwyrm.description: 游荡荒野的绿鳞野兽。会喷吐火焰

gore_idol.title: gore_idol
gore_idol.name: Gore Idol
gore_idol.description: 为无名鲜血之神建造的诅咒神像
gore_idol.rumor: 旅人声称“无名之血”曾统治此地

bramblemonk.title: bramblemonk
bramblemonk.name: Bramble Priest
bramblemonk.description: 侍奉桀骜藤蔓的绿袍侍僧。崇拜一片很久以前被毁的神圣林地
bramblemonk.rumor: 此处有一座被藤蔓缠绕、正在崩塌的祭坛
bramblemonk.taunt: [color=#70af00]Bramble Priest[/color] 在你的胸膛中催生出一条藤蔓……

witheredimp.title: witheredimp
witheredimp.name: Withered Imp
witheredimp.description: 被地狱位面放逐的恶魔贱民。如今为 Deathdrake 效力，散播枯萎
witheredimp.rumor: 你看见一座由病态绿焰照亮的祭坛
witheredimp.taunt: [color=#a0a000]Withered Imp[/color] 用污秽权杖轻触了你……

TethicMonk.title: TethicMonk
TethicMonk.name: Tethic Monk
TethicMonk.description: Tethic 法师的失败学徒。通过神圣扭曲寻求赦免。以腐蚀性的牙齿攻击
TethicMonk.rumor: 此处有大片游移的腐蚀岩石

icebeetle.title: icebeetle
icebeetle.name: Ice Beetle
icebeetle.description: 从北方冰洞中被驱逐出来的巨型疾行野兽
icebeetle.rumor: 你看见一副正在腐烂的蓝色外骨骼
icebeetle.taunt: [color=#5070ff]Ice Beetle[/color] 用一波寒霜浇透了你……

firedrake.title: firedrake
firedrake.name: Firedrake
firedrake.description: 来自辽阔地下熔岩平原的蜿蜒野兽
firedrake.rumor: 你闻到烟味。大地在颤抖
firedrake.intro:
[color=#ff7000]Firedrake[/color] 咆哮！

热……难以忍受的炽热……
firedrake.taunt: [color=#ff7000]Firedrake[/color] 胜利地咆哮。你的身体被火焰覆盖……

deathdrake.title: deathdrake
deathdrake.name: Deathdrake
deathdrake.description: 曾经高贵的龙兽，被死亡之门诅咒，化作腐朽的狂怒化身而活
deathdrake.intro:
[color=#a0a000]Deathdrake[/color] 恶毒地嘶鸣！

恶臭……污秽的气息……
deathdrake.taunt: [color=#a0a000]Deathdrake[/color] 发出令人作呕的咆哮。你的身体枯萎了……

slagh_astromancer.title: slagh_astromancer
slagh_astromancer.name: Slagh Astromancer
slagh_astromancer.description: 深林中受尊崇的星之舞者。Slagh 部族的维齐尔
slagh_astromancer.rumor: 此处有一座巨大的头骨堆，上面覆盖着苔藓和闪光紫花
slagh_astromancer.intro:
[color=#30af40]Slagh Astromancer[/color] 向你作出手势……

“哦，朝圣者……饥饿群星的野兽……我的战利品……”
slagh_astromancer.taunt: [color=#30af40]Slagh Astromancer[/color] 围着你昏迷的身体起舞。一道紫罗兰色裂隙出现了……
phrase: 我们的维齐尔正等着汝……

burrowking.title: burrowking
burrowking.name: Burrow King
burrowking.rumor: 你看见一座由粪便制成的恐怖雕像。它呈王冠形状
burrowking.intro:
[color=#c0c040]Burrow King[/color] 从粪堆中升起……

“吱吱”……何等恐怖的高贵……
burrowking.taunt: [color=#c0c040]Burrow King[/color] 发出命令般的尖叫。你的身体被刺穿……

gil_elga.title: gil_elga
gil_elga.name: Gil-Elga
gil_elga.description: 地下沼泽的爬行动物王子。崇拜无名鲜血之神
gil_elga.rumor: 你看见一座沾满鲜血的爬行动物圣祠
gil_elga.intro:
[color=#ff4040]Gil-Elga[/color] 举起镰刀……

鲜血之神近在咫尺……

golden_litter.title: golden_litter
golden_litter.name: Golden Litter
golden_litter.description: 堆满“活金”的平台。受到 Hobgoblins 珍视与崇拜
golden_litter.rumor: 你听见关于“活金”的传闻
golden_litter.intro:
[color=#f0a000]Golden Litter[/color] 被抬起……

闪烁的光。怪异的热……
phrase: 哦，闪耀之物……哦，美丽之物……

aciddrake.title: aciddrake
aciddrake.name: Hamidrake
aciddrake.description: 诞生于酸池的盲眼笨重野兽
aciddrake.rumor: 高塔上层似乎已被溶解。你闻到岩石融化的气味
aciddrake.intro:
[color=#ffd000]Hamidrake[/color] 嘶鸣！

污秽渗流……吞噬一切……

boga.title: boga
boga.name: Boga
boga.description: 来自地下海的陶土色扭动蛇类
boga.rumor: 地面上散落着脱落的鳞片
boga.taunt: [color=#af4040]Boga[/color] 用盘卷的身体缠住了你……

ratman_phalangite.title: ratman_phalangite
ratman_phalangite.name: Rat-man Phalangite
ratman_phalangite.description: 鼠人殖群中纪律严明的守卫
ratman_phalangite.rumor: 鼠人在此升起了他们的旗帜

Eldite.title: Eldite
Eldite.name: Eldite
Eldite.description: Thunder Priests 麾下持枪的仆从
Eldite.rumor: 你看见一柄被丢弃的长枪，上面刻有雷霆符文
Eldite.taunt: [color=#0060ff]Edlite[/color] 刺穿了你：“哦，祭司！见证我！”……

Gehen.title: Gehen
Gehen.name: Gehen
Gehen.description: 死亡之门剥去皮肤的流放者。侍奉一名流浪 Skin Priest
Gehen.rumor: 你看见被丢弃的腐肉皮片
Gehen.taunt: [color=#a0a000]Gehen[/color] 剥下你的皮：“哦，祭司！哦，枯萎的主人们！”……

slagh_rider.title: slagh_rider
slagh_rider.name: Slagh Rider
slagh_rider.description: 骑乘巨大战犬的迅捷劫掠者。Slagh 部族的斗士
slagh_rider.rumor: 你看见一颗头骨，上面刻着犬形图案
slagh_rider.taunt: [color=#30af40]Slagh Rider[/color] 用钩刀割开了你的喉咙……

wechuge.title: wechuge
wechuge.name: Wechuge
wechuge.description: 由冰封荒原一位惊才绝艳的 Arjana 法师以寒冰与法术造出的灵兽
wechuge.rumor: 你看见一堆堆非自然的蓝冰

Fera.title: Fera
Fera.name: Ferod
Fera.description: 由恶意藤蔓构成的元素团块。侍奉一片很久以前被毁的神圣森林那复仇意志
Fera.rumor: 据说邪恶藤蔓生长于此

bugbear.title: bugbear
bugbear.name: Obar
bugbear.description: 从深林中被驱逐出来的人形蛮怪与食童者

sporebeast.title: sporebeast
sporebeast.name: Sporebeast
sporebeast.description: 在剧毒外壳下蹒跚行走的奇异生物。从北方污秽谷地被驱逐而来
sporebeast.rumor: 此处有散发刺鼻气味的巨大苔藓巢穴

torch_priest.title: torch_priest
torch_priest.name: Torch Priest
torch_priest.rumor: 你看见一条道路，两侧排列着烧焦尸体与红布碎片
torch_priest.taunt: [color=#ff7000]Torch Priest[/color] 歌唱：“哦，火焰！哦，美丽的火焰！”……

irga_priest.title: irga_priest
irga_priest.name: Irga Priest
irga_priest.description: 来自地狱位面上方隧道的狂喜教徒。主持鲜血节庆
irga_priest.rumor: 有传闻说，此地有佩戴黄金的劫掠者
irga_priest.taunt: [color=#ff0070]Irga Priest[/color] 在狂野舞蹈中跺动猩红双足……

golganth.title: golganth
golganth.name: Golganth
golganth.description: 游荡荒野、以尸体为食的有翼野兽
golganth.rumor: 有黑暗野兽在此狩猎。这片土地已被清空生命

chimerabeetle.title: chimerabeetle
chimerabeetle.name: Chimera Beetle
chimerabeetle.description: 充满不稳定魔法的巨型甲虫。诞生于地下沼泽
chimerabeetle.rumor: 你发现一片奇异虹彩甲壳的残骸
chimerabeetle.taunt: [color=#ff00ff]Chimera Beetle[/color] 踩踏你烧焦的身体……

bluewyrmrider.title: bluewyrmrider
bluewyrmrider.name: Storm Knight
bluewyrmrider.description: 风暴神殿的流放战士。与一头无翼 Blue Wyrm 缔结羁绊
bluewyrmrider.rumor: 你察觉到蓝色金属短暂闪光
bluewyrmrider.taunt: [color=#3060ff]Storm Knight[/color] 击倒了你：“汝之荣耀到此为止”……

heliot.title: heliot
heliot.name: Heliot
heliot.description: 持附魔酸刃起舞的苍白战士。从盐原朝圣而来
heliot.rumor: 据说苍白战士潜伏于此

thunderdrake.title: thunderdrake
thunderdrake.name: Thunderdrake
thunderdrake.description: 曾栖居于 Achra 风暴神殿的傲慢野兽
thunderdrake.rumor: 你听见非自然风暴的回声
thunderdrake.intro:
The [color=#0060ff]Thunderdrake[/color] roars!

Sparks dance through the air...
thunderdrake.taunt: [color=#0060ff]Thunderdrake[/color] 发出刺耳咆哮。你的身体被闪电填满……

venomdrake.title: venomdrake
venomdrake.name: Fumedrake
venomdrake.description: 由毒雾构成的致命野兽。诞生于北方污秽谷地，被 Brud 猎手驱赶南下
venomdrake.rumor: 你听见污秽蒸汽的嘶声
venomdrake.intro:
The [color=#50ff00]Fumedrake[/color] roars!

A deadly stench billows...
venomdrake.taunt: [color=#50ff00]Fumedrake[/color] 愉悦地嘶鸣。你的身体屈服于翻腾疾病……

umbrarch.title: umbrarch
umbrarch.name: Umbrarch
umbrarch.description: 被星路驱逐的傲慢恶魔战士。以狂妄之角为标记
umbrarch.rumor: 你观察到一群神志错乱的信徒。他们声称追随“暗影之神”
umbrarch.intro:
The [color=#8030af]Umbrarch[/color] raises a shimmering blade...

"Little pilgrim...you have climbed so high..."

irga_knight.title: irga_knight
irga_knight.name: Irga Knight
irga_knight.description: Irga 隧道的斗士。受“活金”铠甲保护
irga_knight.rumor: 恐惧的旅人谈起“黄金之王”
irga_knight.intro:
The [color=#ff0070]Irga Knight[/color] blocks your path...

"O lord of dismemberment...witness my axe..."
irga_knight.taunt: [color=#ff0070]Irga Knight[/color] 将你一分为二……“主啊……荣耀我……”

ikuma.title: ikuma
ikuma.name: Ikuma
ikuma.description: 被 Surtmir 氏族流放的堕落法师巨人
ikuma.rumor: 奇异的红蓝火焰在空中变幻
ikuma.intro:
The [color=#5070ff]Ikuma[/color] beats its chest!

"O stench of fire! O ripple of ice!"
ikuma.taunt: [color=#5070ff]Ikuma[/color] 在你冻结的身体上方吼出颂咒……

ruk.title: ruk
ruk.name: Ruk
ruk.description: 来自巨人之岛的壮丽巨鹰

caveworm.title: caveworm
caveworm.name: Cave Worm
caveworm.description: 在世界下方开凿隧道的泰坦巨虫
caveworm.rumor: 你看见大地破裂出的深邃裂隙
caveworm.intro: The [color=#704030]Cave Worm[/color] emerges from the depths!
caveworm.taunt: [color=#704030]Cave Worm[/color] 用沉重盘卷将你碾成粉末……

RedFlower.title: RedFlower
RedFlower.name: RedFlower
RedFlower.description: 拥有燃烧花苞的怪异花朵。体现着一片神圣林地的愤怒，那里曾庇护一位女神的子嗣
RedFlower.rumor: 奇异红花附着在墙上。你闻到灰烬气味
RedFlower.intro:
The [color=#70af00]Red Flower[/color] blooms!

Stench of rage...
RedFlower.taunt: [color=#70af00]Red Flower[/color] 将你拖入它沸腾的花苞……

fey_partisan.title: fey_partisan
fey_partisan.name: Fey Partisan
fey_partisan.description: 禁行之路上隐秘的军阀。蔑视一切凡人
fey_partisan.rumor: 一面细长的藤绿色旗帜在风中起伏
fey_partisan.taunt: [color=#20af60]Fey Partisan[/color] 用令人作呕的长枪刺向你……

taggla_idol.title: taggla_idol
taggla_idol.name: Taggla Idol
taggla_idol.description: 一团在共同梦境中结合的 Taggla 蠕虫。被盐原可怜朝圣者奉为神祇
taggla_idol.rumor: 旅人声称“纠缠之虫”曾统治此地

RukThrall.title: RukThrall
RukThrall.name: Ruk-Thrall
RukThrall.description: 强大 Ruk 的狂信仆从

Brungle.title: Brungle
Brungle.name: Brungle
Brungle.description: 拥有惊人力量的隧道居民。崇拜无名掘地野兽
Brungle.rumor: 你听见地下传来金属般的拖步声

skin_priest.title: skin_priest
skin_priest.name: Skin Priest
skin_priest.description: Eresh 孤独的叛道者。以可怜方式模仿 Morlocks，复活皮肤。被死亡之门流放
skin_priest.rumor: 你看见一座粗陋祭坛的残骸。你闻到腐肉气味
skin_priest.taunt: [color=#a0a000]Skin Priest[/color] 歌唱：“哦，死亡！哦，足步轻捷的死亡！”……

writhing_monk.title: writhing_monk
writhing_monk.name: Writhing Monk
writhing_monk.description: 疯狂的秘术师，其身体很久以前便与星界黑暗中的生物融合
writhing_monk.rumor: 你看见盘卷甲壳组成的环

thunder_priest.title: thunder_priest
thunder_priest.name: Thunder Priest
thunder_priest.description: Hadad 的叛道者。抛弃 Achra 的风暴神殿，转而崇拜 Thunderdrake 之血
thunder_priest.rumor: 你看见一座闪耀蓝光的祭坛。风在呼啸
thunder_priest.taunt: [color=#0060ff]Thunder Priest[/color] 歌唱：“哦，风暴！哦，华美的毁灭！”……

MaskedZealot.title: MaskedZealot
MaskedZealot.name: Masked Zealot
MaskedZealot.description: Yellow Priests 麾下挥剑的追随者。曾作为盐原 Heliot 生活
MaskedZealot.rumor: 石头上带有奇异的黄色标记
MaskedZealot.taunt: [color=#dfdf30]Masked Zealot[/color] 猛扑而来：“哦，祭司！哦，无尽思绪”……

Zahrat.title: Zahrat
Zahrat.name: Zahrat
Zahrat.description: 兰花教团的誓约守卫。挥舞一柄穿透性的金色斧
Zahrat.taunt: [color=#af30df]Zahrat[/color] 挥动金色斧：“哦，神圣之花！赐我悲惨”……

Kiggak.title: Kiggak
Kiggak.name: Kiggak
Kiggak.description: 冰封荒原的孤儿，如今受束缚而侍奉 Ice Priests

fey_scout.title: fey_scout
fey_scout.name: Fey Scout
fey_scout.description: 来自禁行之路的隐秘妖精
fey_scout.rumor: 你听见微弱而尖细的笑声合唱
fey_scout.taunt: [color=#20af60]Fey[/color] 咯咯发笑。你的身体麻木了……

umbralith.title: umbralith
umbralith.name: Umbralith
umbralith.description: 虚空中的幻影恐怖；Fawdaa 的反叛子嗣。由一具 Pentot 尸体诞生

rhombid.title: rhombid
rhombid.name: Rhombid
rhombid.description: 从星界心灵巢穴召来的悬浮构装体。据说会成群穿过“角之门”抵达
rhombid.taunt: [color=#ffaf30]Rhombid[/color] 发出震耳嗡鸣。你的心智消失了……

acidbeast.title: acidbeast
acidbeast.name: Acid Beast
acidbeast.description: 从 Hamidrake 尸体中召出的狂乱元素酸液团块
acidbeast.rumor: 你看见被溶解的铠甲残片

longlegs.title: longlegs
longlegs.name: Longlegs
longlegs.description: 从隧道之地受侵染洞窟中孵出的巨型蜘蛛
longlegs.rumor: 你闻到令人警觉的虫类麝香
longlegs.taunt: [color=#90a050]Longlegs[/color] 俯身压向你。它兴奋地吱吱作响……

surtmir.title: surtmir
surtmir.name: Surtmir
surtmir.description: 曾横行 Achra 的残暴战士。诞生于裂隙之地的一座火山
surtmir.rumor: 你看见燃烧寒冰的螺旋

starbrute.title: starbrute
starbrute.name: Star-Brute
starbrute.description: 从星路坠落的暴力战士
starbrute.rumor: 怪异的紫罗兰色闪电在头顶脉动

shesha.title: shesha
shesha.name: Shesha
shesha.description: 来自地下海陶土城邦的赤色爬行动物
shesha.rumor: 你看见一座祭坛，上面绘有黑色波浪与紫罗兰色星辰
shesha.taunt: [color=#a05090]Shesha[/color] 敲打盾牌。它发出爬行动物般的尖啸……

bloodrevenant.title: bloodrevenant
bloodrevenant.name: Blood Revenant
bloodrevenant.description: 由无名鲜血之神驱动的久死战士
bloodrevenant.rumor: 你看见破碎武器的残骸。你闻到血腥味

taurid.title: taurid
taurid.name: Taurid
taurid.description: Mardok 暴力野兽的野性后裔

cinderbeast.title: cinderbeast
cinderbeast.name: Cinderbeast
cinderbeast.description: 从环境热量中汲取生命的蹒跚生物。被 Agni 教徒从燃烧之地驱逐出来
cinderbeast.rumor: 你看见发光红苔组成的巢穴

ogre.title: ogre
ogre.name: Ogre
ogre.description: 食人的半巨人，有时被称为“饥饿之神”。很久以前曾居住在 Achra 的神殿之地
ogre.rumor: 据说“饥饿之神”住在这里
ogre.intro:
The [color=#af7020]Ogre[/color] raises its blood-drenched club!

There is an incredible stench of gore...
ogre.taunt: [color=#af7020]Ogre[/color] 将你举向它流涎的大口……

drakon.title: drakon
drakon.name: Hierophant
drakon.description: 呈现半龙形态的巫师祭司。挥舞一根受诅咒的金杖
drakon.rumor: 你看见一座龙形雕像，上面装饰着金色宝珠
drakon.intro:
The [color=#009000]Hierophant[/color] grimaces...

"Little pilgrim...In the hour of flood..."

metalith.title: metalith
metalith.name: Metalith
metalith.description: Umbraliths 凝结而成的团块。因吞食星辰而被虚空放逐
metalith.rumor: 天空中充满怪异的闪烁光芒

basilisk.title: basilisk
basilisk.name: Basilisk
basilisk.description: 生而病态、长着公鸡头的蛇。死亡之门中枯萎祭司的实验产物。会给所有接近者带来厄运
basilisk.rumor: 地面被盘绕的枯萎痕迹破坏

tupilaq.title: tupilaq
tupilaq.name: Tupilaq
tupilaq.description: 来自冰封荒原、长有鹿角的杀戮灵体。被道路上的绝望吸引
tupilaq.rumor: 高塔上结满非自然的旋涡状冰壳
tupilaq.intro:
The [color=#109090]Tupilaq[/color] moans!

Sharp smell of ice...

keliot.title: keliot
keliot.name: Keliot
keliot.description: 来自黎明沼泽的爬行动物猎手王子。推翻蛇王的 ur-keliot 后裔
keliot.rumor: 潮湿的风拂过你。空气中有刺鼻的爬行动物臭味
keliot.intro:
The [color=#609010]Keliot[/color] emerges from the shadows!

"O hunted one..."

tethic_knight.title: tethic_knight
tethic_knight.name: Tethic Knight
tethic_knight.description: Tethic 教团的领主。装备一柄仪式性的獠牙刀
tethic_knight.rumor: 据说此地被一位“众口之主”萦绕
tethic_knight.intro:
The [color=#5040a0]Tethic Knight[/color] gestures at you!

"O friendly teeth...beloved consumption..."

agarithum.title: agarithum
agarithum.name: Agarithum
agarithum.description: 吞噬时间的野兽与真菌主人。由一名星界心灵巢穴的恶魔逃出“角之门”后生成
agarithum.rumor: 巨大的模糊真菌丝缠绕着高塔表面
agarithum.taunt: [color=#904060]Agarithum[/color] 用颤动的粉色孢子覆盖了你……

fire_mouth.title: fire_mouth
fire_mouth.name: Mouth of Fire
fire_mouth.description: 燃烧之地的附魔构装体。由已故战争女王的狂信工匠建造，用以孵化 Fire Snakes
fire_mouth.rumor: 你看见翻涌的橙色烟线

AgnitarIdol.title: AgnitarIdol
AgnitarIdol.name: Agni Idol
AgnitarIdol.description: 一座藏有星界火焰的实心青铜圣祠。古老毁灭之神 Agni 的导管
AgnitarIdol.rumor: 旅人声称“Agni 的意志”曾统治此地
AgnitarIdol.taunt: [color=#ff9040]Agni Idol[/color] 将你托付给它的紫罗兰色火焰

orchidwretch.title: orchidwretch
orchidwretch.name: Orchid Wretch
orchidwretch.rumor: 腐败花朵浓烈的气味让你皱起鼻子
orchidwretch.taunt: [color=#af30df]Orchid Wretch[/color] 歌唱：“哦，欢愉！哦，不可战胜的吞噬！”

yellowpriest.title: yellowpriest
yellowpriest.name: Yellow Priest
yellowpriest.rumor: 你看见一座万人坑，里面是身穿黄袍的无头朝圣者
yellowpriest.taunt: [color=#dfdf30]Yellow Priest[/color] 歌唱：“哦，丰美！哦，垂死心灵的果实！”

icepriest.title: icepriest
icepriest.name: Ice Priest
icepriest.rumor: 你看见覆盖蓝色破布的鹿角人偶
icepriest.taunt: [color=#109090]Ice Priest[/color] 吟诵：“哦，寒冰！哦，闪耀的湮灭！”

acroserpent.title: acroserpent
acroserpent.name: Acroserpent
acroserpent.description: 来自黎明沼泽的巨蛇。由 Keliots 释放，用以耗尽猎物
acroserpent.rumor: 道路两旁排列着被勒死、消化到一半的尸体
acroserpent.taunt: [color=#609010]Acroserpent[/color] 用盘卷的身体束缚了你……

agarite.title: agarite
agarite.name: Agarite
agarite.description: 由奇异噬心真菌赋予力量的教徒
agarite.rumor: 你看见颤动真菌留下的痕迹

gibbousmouth.title: gibbousmouth
gibbousmouth.name: Gibbous Mouth
gibbousmouth.description: 由 Tethic 法师为战争生成的抽搐恐怖
gibbousmouth.rumor: 此处有被剔净血肉的完整骨架

firewasp.title: firewasp
firewasp.name: Fire Wasp
firewasp.description: 带有燃烧螫针的群聚昆虫。由众神沙漠中的禁忌仪式创造
firewasp.rumor: 你听见凶猛的虫类嗡鸣。你闻到烟味
firewasp.taunt: [color=#ff7000]Fire Wasp[/color] 落在你麻痹的身体上……

irongolem.title: irongolem
irongolem.name: Iron Giant
irongolem.description: 由隧道之地一名叛 rogue ferromancer 赋予生命的金属构装体
irongolem.rumor: 你听见巨大的脚步声，以及沉闷的金属回响

sebek_priest.title: sebek_priest
sebek_priest.name: Sebek Priest
sebek_priest.description: 来自墙影星界沼泽的爬行动物秘术师。陪伴一名战士踏上前往 Achra 的旅程
sebek_priest.rumor: 你看见一枚粉色符记。此处有令人不安的沼泽气味
sebek_priest.taunt: [color=#a000ff]Sebek Priest[/color] 在你受折磨的身体上方诵念咒文……

deathknight.title: deathknight
deathknight.name: Death Knight
deathknight.description: 被死亡之门流放的阴森战士法师。在世界尽头追求秘密的“解放仪式”
deathknight.rumor: 你看见一堆被杀死且剥去皮肤的 Flesh Priests

moroidknight.title: moroidknight
moroidknight.name: Moroid Knight
moroidknight.description: 来自污秽谷地的狂信战士祭司。崇拜一位被称为“刺痛之树”的难解实体
moroidknight.rumor: 你看见一面翡翠色旗帜，上面描绘着带刺之树
moroidknight.taunt: [color=#509f60]Moroid Knight[/color] 在你的血肉中种下一颗燃烧种子……

grangadancer.title: grangadancer
grangadancer.name: Granga Dancer
grangadancer.description: 来自冰冷裂隙之地的奇异青铜面具战士
grangadancer.rumor: 你看见奇异的寒冰图案

samnite.title: samnite
samnite.name: Fallen Samnite
samnite.description: Obelisk 的杀戮哨卫。猎取朝圣者作为战利品
samnite.rumor: 此处有带着金色符记的华美旗帜

filthrevenant.title: filthrevenant
filthrevenant.name: Filth Revenant
filthrevenant.description: 由死亡之门祭司驱动的诅咒战士灵体
filthrevenant.rumor: 一股腐臭诅咒萦绕此地
filthrevenant.taunt: [color=#a0a000]Filth Revenant[/color] 用污秽小刀剜开了你……

horrorgolem.title: horrorgolem
horrorgolem.name: Horror Giant
horrorgolem.description: 由闪烁易变物质构成的高耸身影。世界尽头的神……除非……
horrorgolem.rumor: 世界尽头的神矗立在这里……
horrorgolem.intro:
The [color=#af9060]Horror Giant[/color] apprehends you!

"Little pilgrim...The end is near..."

voggite.title: voggite
voggite.name: Voggite
voggite.description: 从虚空召下、吞食 Achra 大地的扭曲水银形体。某个升格力量的意志形态……
voggite.rumor: 一个无思的形体在此进食……
voggite.intro:
The [color=#af9060]Voggite[/color] emerges through a slit in the air!

The walls vibrate. Sour smell of metal...

robak.title: robak
robak.name: Robak
robak.description: 从“被吞噬之星”召来的喷火苍白舞者。守护禁忌之门……
robak.rumor: 一头盘卷野兽在火红天空中闪现……
robak.intro:
The [color=#af9060]Robak[/color] writhes forth!

O pale dancer...

JeweledVisage.title: JeweledVisage
JeweledVisage.name: Jeweled Visage
JeweledVisage.description: 一张镶嵌宝石、苍白而无情的石面。被紫袍教徒奉为“神圣之花”。目睹它令人悲惨……
JeweledVisage.rumor: 一群紫袍教徒恍惚站立：“哦，花朵……哦，不动之面……黑暗之外……”
JeweledVisage.intro:
The [color=#af9060]Jeweled Visage[/color] rises!

O wretched sight!
JeweledVisage.taunt: [color=#af9060]Jeweled Visage[/color] 令你僵立……一阵颤抖的呼吸……

jawhara.title: jawhara
jawhara.name: Jawhara
jawhara.description: 在星界黑暗中轮转迁移的水晶实体
jawhara.rumor: 光芒似乎冻结成正在浮现的奇异形状

okokorpus.title: okokorpus
okokorpus.name: Okokorpus
okokorpus.description: 由被吞噬之星的尸体生成的多眼恐怖
okokorpus.rumor: 你闻到一颗腐朽星辰的气味

demongreen.title: demongreen
demongreen.name: Green Demon
demongreen.description: 怪诞渗流的恶魔。从生命与死亡的流变中积聚形体
demongreen.rumor: 你隐约察觉一个庞大形体在群星之间移动

demonred.title: demonred
demonred.name: Red Demon
demonred.description: 诞生于血之虚空的炽火恶魔
demonred.rumor: 此处群星似乎正在冒烟。你感觉它灼烧着你的皮肤
demonred.taunt: [color=#ff0050]Red Demon[/color] 将你的鲜血化作烟雾……

demonwhite.title: demonwhite
demonwhite.name: White Demon
demonwhite.description: 由白色水晶构成的恶魔。诞生于被吞噬之星的烟气
demonwhite.rumor: 你感到一种可怕而碾压性的空白

demongold.title: demongold
demongold.name: Gold Demon
demongold.description: 由耀眼黄光构成的恶魔。心灵巢穴与角之门的守护者。据说诞生于“心灵尽头的房间”
demongold.rumor: 你听见声音在呼唤。奇异的念头……

demonviolet.title: demonviolet
demonviolet.name: Violet Demon
demonviolet.description: 从冲击星界之墙的混沌中诞生的闪光恶魔；那是“群星之间的风”

arbiter.title: arbiter
arbiter.name: Arbiter
arbiter.rumor: 群星之间似乎形成了一条黄金道路

devilred.title: devilred
devilred.name: Baalus
devilred.description: 地狱位面中召唤小恶魔的公爵。穿行于地狱裂隙
devilred.rumor: 你闻到硫磺恶臭。黑暗中裂开猩红缝隙

icewasp.title: icewasp
icewasp.name: Ice Wasp
icewasp.description: 被寒冰扭曲畸变的昆虫。由 Achra 的一名冰法师释放，用以入侵虚空
icewasp.rumor: 你听见尖厉的虫鸣。巨大的寒意袭来
icewasp.taunt: [color=#5080ff]Ice Wasp[/color] 扑向你冻结的身体……

kolec.title: kolec
kolec.name: Kolec
kolec.description: 一具八尖晶体形体，沿星路迁徙转生
kolec.rumor: 锐利的浅绿色碎片沿闪光轨迹漂浮
kolec.taunt: [color=#50ff90]Kolec[/color] 用晶体尖刺刺穿了你的身体……

gora.title: gora
gora.name: Gora
gora.description: 被虚空放逐、嗜血无尽的猎犬
gora.rumor: 你听见一阵低沉喉音的嚎叫合声

Malad.title: Malad
Malad.name: Malaga
Malad.description: 诞生于鲜血虚空的星兽。盘旋的血肉舞者，在下方诸地有时被称为“夜蛇”
Malad.rumor: 有暗淡红光浮现。某物在黑暗中盘旋

Pentot.title: Pentot
Pentot.name: Pentot
Pentot.description: 星路上的五眼苦行战士。挥舞一柄扰乱星界之刃
Pentot.rumor: 你看见一面漂浮旗帜，上面绘着五眼面具
Pentot.taunt: [color=#8030af]Pentot[/color] 撕开你的胸膛……“哦，迅疾的凡死”

Firebird.title: Firebird
Firebird.name: Firebird
Firebird.description: 星路上的火焰野兽。女神 Phoenix 曾为 Achra 带来光明，而它是那光的一道狂野折射
Firebird.rumor: 你看见一道道炽火光痕。你听见虚灵羽翼的拍动

king.title: king
king.name: King of Many Colors
king.description: 来自星界之墙外的入侵者。恶魔召唤者。“曾经流浪的王”。扭曲之光的主人
king.rumor: 一道孤独身影立于星石之上……
king.intro:
[color=#9030ff]King of Many Colors[/color] 出现了！

“哦，门徒们……”
king.taunt: [color=#9030ff]King of Many Colors[/color] 将你投入深渊……

king2.title: king2
king2.name: King of Many Colors
king2.description: 来自星界之墙外的入侵者。恶魔召唤者。“曾经流浪的王”。扭曲之光的主人
king2.rumor: 一道孤独身影立于星石之上……
king2.intro:
[color=#ff9030]King of Many Colors[/color] 出现了！

“哦，门徒们……”
king2.taunt: [color=#ff9030]King of Many Colors[/color] 将你投入深渊……

king3.title: king3
king3.name: King of Many Colors
king3.description: 来自星界之墙外的入侵者。恶魔召唤者。“曾经流浪的王”。扭曲之光的主人
king3.rumor: 一道孤独身影立于星石之上……
king3.intro:
[color=#3090ff]King of Many Colors[/color] 出现了！

“哦，门徒们……”
king3.taunt: [color=#3090ff]King of Many Colors[/color] 将你投入深渊……

king4.title: king4
king4.name: King of Many Colors
king4.description: 来自星界之墙外的入侵者。恶魔召唤者。“曾经流浪的王”。扭曲之光的主人
king4.rumor: 一道孤独身影立于星石之上……
king4.intro:
The [color=#30ff90]King of Many Colors[/color] appears!

"O disciples..."
king4.taunt: [color=#30ff90]King of Many Colors[/color] 将你投入深渊……

ratman_archer.title: ratman_archer
ratman_archer.name: Rat-man Peltast
ratman_archer.description: 一种生活在成群殖群中的人形啮齿生物

Bramble.title: Bramble
Bramble.name: Bramble
Bramble.description: 被 Bramble Priest 囚禁的永生藤蔓碎片

gore_nymph.title: gore_nymph
gore_nymph.name: Gore Nymph
gore_nymph.description: 由附魔血肉泉生成的鲜血灵体

golden_wretch.title: golden_wretch
golden_wretch.name: Golden Wretch
golden_wretch.description: Hobgoblins 所崇拜的纯粹“活金”子嗣

lapsi.title: lapsi
lapsi.name: Lapsi
lapsi.description: 从 Thunder Egg 中孵出的“风暴之子”

BurningBody.title: BurningBody
BurningBody.name: Burning Body
BurningBody.description: Torch Priest 的毁灭性灵意

astropede.title: astropede
astropede.name: Astropede
astropede.description: 从星界黑暗中召来的模糊生物。它的颚能绕过护甲

dancing_flesh.title: dancing_flesh
dancing_flesh.name: Dancing Flesh
dancing_flesh.description: Skin Priest 从受伤敌人身上取出的诅咒血肉皮片

hound.title: hound
hound.name: Hound
hound.taunt: [color=#f0a060]Hound[/color] 咬住你的喉咙。你的膝盖瘫软下去……

taggla.title: taggla
taggla.name: Taggla-worm
taggla.description: 从沉睡于众神沙漠下方的神圣 Worm 躯体上断裂下来的节段。迟钝而毁灭心智的野兽

sebek_warrior.title: sebek_warrior
sebek_warrior.name: Sebek Warrior
sebek_warrior.description: 来自墙影星界沼泽的爬行动物战士。总是陪伴一名 Sebek Priest，那是在闪光泥沼中与它立誓的对象

moroidzealot.title: moroidzealot
moroidzealot.name: Moroid Zealot
moroidzealot.description: 伟大“刺痛之树”的佝偻追随者
moroidzealot.taunt: [color=#509f60]Moroid Zealot[/color] 将你的身体献给它的主人……

impred.title: impred
impred.name: Red Imp
impred.description: 从地狱位面召来的拍翼大肚仆从

okopod.title: okopod
okopod.name: Okopod
okopod.description: 从 Okokorpus 分裂出的一群悬浮眼睛

MindPalm.title: MindPalm
MindPalm.name: Mind-Palm
MindPalm.description: A glinting stalk of the mind-warren. Was once a Yellow Priest. Projects its empty thought

MaskedApostle.title: MaskedApostle
MaskedApostle.name: Masked Apostle
MaskedApostle.description: A grey-robed shapeless adulant of the Yellow Queen. Wields a golden spear
MaskedApostle.rumor: You see a hunched procession moving through the gate

MindPalmFruiting.title: MindPalmFruiting
MindPalmFruiting.name: Fruiting Mind-Palm
MindPalmFruiting.description: A glinting stalk hung with a sightless golden face. Lunges with blurring speed. Spews cursed breath
MindPalmFruiting.rumor: You perceive a faint forest of gold
MindPalmFruiting.taunt: The [color=#ffaf50]Fruiting Mind-Palm[/color] vomits a putrid cloud...

YellowQueen.title: YellowQueen
YellowQueen.name: Yellow Queen
YellowQueen.description: Masked regent sent to the gate of horn. Exiled long ago from a broken tower. Awaits the 'wandering king' of the star-path. Presides over monstrosities of thought
YellowQueen.rumor: A faraway voice whispers "Her mask is raised"...
YellowQueen.intro:
The [color=#ffaf50]Yellow Queen[/color] appears!

"O Pilgrim...thy king is near..."

Kasharite.title: Kasharite
Kasharite.name: Kasharite
Kasharite.description: A jubilant imp from the infernal plane. Sojourned to the stars for the grand 'dance of reddening.' Wields a magic crook
Kasharite.rumor: You see the dim outline of florid dancers

YearningEye.title: YearningEye
YearningEye.name: Yearning Eye
YearningEye.description: A huge eye sprouted from the yearning of the 'inner blood.' Attacks all in sight with rending gore
YearningEye.rumor: Something watches from within the gore-clouds

BloodWretch.title: BloodWretch
BloodWretch.name: Blood Wretch
BloodWretch.description: A mindless warrior summoned from the korpus of "the one in red." Attacks with a blade of bone
BloodWretch.rumor: You hear the click of strange bones

RedPrince.title: RedPrince
RedPrince.name: Prince in Red
RedPrince.description: Once a prince of Achra famous for his ruddy mask. Followed the 'wandering king' of lost Shuppurak into the stars. Presides over the 'inner blood' with a mighty axe...
RedPrince.rumor: In the red depth you sense a gathering of bodies...
RedPrince.intro:
The [color=#ff2020]Prince in Red[/color] bellows! 

"Gift of flesh...my spirit claims thee!"
RedPrince.taunt: The [color=#ff2020]Prince in Red[/color] raises his dripping axe "O pilgrim...thy yearning beckons..."

TrodBeast.title: TrodBeast
TrodBeast.name: Trod Beast
TrodBeast.description: A lumbering vine-born beast of the ancient world. Banished to the trod. Crushes its prey with woody fists

FeyRedCrest.title: FeyRedCrest
FeyRedCrest.name: Fey Red-Crest
FeyRedCrest.description: A fey warrior adorned with a red crest of long curling feathers. Wields a ribbon-wrapped staff
FeyRedCrest.taunt: The [color=#af2060]Fey Red-Crest[/color] bashes you with a red-ribboned staff...

FeyBlueCrest.title: FeyBlueCrest
FeyBlueCrest.name: Fey Blue-Crest
FeyBlueCrest.description: A fey warrior adorned with a crest of wide blue feathers. Brandishes a wooden pike hung with grandiose ribbons
FeyBlueCrest.rumor: You see a torn red ribbon
FeyBlueCrest.taunt: The [color=#2060af]Fey Blue-Crest[/color] impales you with a blue-ribboned pike...

FeyBanrion.title: FeyBanrion
FeyBanrion.name: Banrion
FeyBanrion.description: A queen of the fey. Guards the vine-draped exit of the trod. Wields a sickle and whip of elemental poison
FeyBanrion.rumor: A strange chorus echos from within the otherworldly vines. A shifting deep-green shadow....
FeyBanrion.intro:
The [color=#20af60]Banrion[/color] cracks her shimmering whip!

"O mortal...thy filthy tread..."
FeyBanrion.taunt: The [color=#20af60]Banrion[/color] brings down her glimmering sickle...

OrichBeetle.title: OrichBeetle
OrichBeetle.name: Orich Beetle
OrichBeetle.description: A lumbering insect born from the vanished craft-queen. Attacks with spines of pale brass
OrichBeetle.rumor: Flecks of brass gleam in the dark
OrichBeetle.taunt: The [color=#5070ff]Orich Beetle[/color] thrashes its spined jaw...

GrangaGutSpiller.title: GrangaGutSpiller
GrangaGutSpiller.name: Granga Gut-Spiller
GrangaGutSpiller.description: A guardian-executioner of the exiled Granga. Animated by a mask of hunger and war. Wields a tassled bi-scythe
GrangaGutSpiller.rumor: Hulking shadows clatter through the dull-lapis halls
GrangaGutSpiller.taunt: The [color=#5070ff]Granga Gut-Spiller[/color] heaves its warped blade...

GrangaRadiant.title: GrangaRadiant
GrangaRadiant.name: Granga Radiant
GrangaRadiant.description: A sacred officiate of the exiled Granga. Animated by a mask of curses and wisdom. Wields a tassle-hung chakram
GrangaRadiant.rumor: You hear the clinking of metal ornaments
GrangaRadiant.taunt: The [color=#5070ff]Granga Radiant[/color] dangles its chakram...perfume of brass...

GrangaResplendent.title: GrangaResplendent
GrangaResplendent.name: Granga Resplendent
GrangaResplendent.description: A many-masked Granga that awaits the return of its queen. Wields its birth mask chilled to dull-turquoise by the groaning winds of the outer stars
GrangaResplendent.rumor: You hear a shrill many-voiced chant echoing from the broken height...
GrangaResplendent.intro:
The [color=#5070ff]Granga Resplendent[/color] emerges from the dull-lapis depths! Its many faces intone...

"O blessed joining...thy proffered visage..."
GrangaResplendent.taunt: The [color=#5070ff]Granga Resplendent[/color]'s many faces bellow... "O gleaming flesh"...

AlgaSebek.title: AlgaSebek
AlgaSebek.name: Alga-Sebek
AlgaSebek.description: A many-armed warlord of the Sebeks. Permitted to hold authority by accepting the fleshly distortion of the Waking Flower. Wields a mighty shield
AlgaSebek.rumor: A strange polis rises above the violet mist

GlimmeringBud.title: GlimmeringBud
GlimmeringBud.name: Glimmering Bud
GlimmeringBud.description: A child of the Waking Flower that seeks to spread its slimed roots through the broken places of the astral wall. Attacks with thrashing violet vines
GlimmeringBud.rumor: Slimed roots stretch through the dark
GlimmeringBud.taunt: The [color=#ff00a0]Glimmering Bud[/color] thrashes you with its foul vines...

Khana.title: Khana
Khana.name: Khana
Khana.description: A writhing serpent that once flew as a Malaga of the blood-void. Transformed by the muck of the astral swamps. Attacks with sickening fangs
Khana.rumor: The muck is rippled by writhing serpentine shapes

WakingFlower.title: WakingFlower
WakingFlower.name: Waking Flower
WakingFlower.description: The moistened edge of the astral wall was once the vital 'estuary' between starlight and flesh. The Waking Flower now claims supremacy; by its perfumed fruits a glimmering dominion is spread...
WakingFlower.rumor: A tall figure sways in the dim perfumed light...
WakingFlower.intro:
The [color=#ff00a0]Waking Flower[/color] stands up!

O strange gust...violet mist...
WakingFlower.taunt: The [color=#ff00a0]Waking Flower[/color] pulls you into its redolent petals...unreal scent...

OkonicBed.title: OkonicBed
OkonicBed.name: Okonic Bed
OkonicBed.description: A living altar sprouted from fields of decaying cosmic waste. Said by grey-robed priests to be a fleshly reincarnation of the divine gaze
OkonicBed.taunt: The [color=#90f0ff]Okonic Bed[/color] shifts its swollen eye...

Krampite.title: Krampite
Krampite.name: Krampite
Krampite.description: An astral scavanger that prowls the dim expanses of devoured light
Krampite.rumor: Hunched shadows prowl between bent spires of cosmic waste

SlouchingBeast.title: SlouchingBeast
SlouchingBeast.name: Okon-moksha
SlouchingBeast.description: A gathering of Okonic bodies bound by a fleck of divine refraction. An engorged star-eater. Pursues self-birth through the animalistic devouring of light
SlouchingBeast.rumor: A quivering bulk slouches in the expanse of dying light
SlouchingBeast.intro:
The [color=#90f0ff]Okon-moksha[/color] quivers!

O hunger...O swelling dark...
